label: Chainlink provider profile
summary: Shared EVM-only Chainlink foundation. Select one exact product through --chainlink-product; this foundation is not a complete product choice.
requiredFacts: Selected Chainlink product and its separately hash-bound product-requirement definition
Exact target chain, provider contract roles, addresses, runtime-code hashes, dependency lock and deployment evidence
Provider callback, report, retry, outage, stale-data, replacement-authority, billing and beneficiary recovery boundaries
Backend-only credential boundary and a profile proving no validation, deployment, approval or transaction authority
Explicit non-coverage of Automation, Functions and alpha Confidential AI in the reviewed source revision
requiredFiles: Content-addressed EVM-only Chainlink provider profile matching chainlink-provider-profile-v1.schema.json
Exact dependency lock and provider deployment evidence
Ethereum liveness, account, indexer/RPC and chain-capability evidence
requiredTests: Wrong chain, address, runtime hash, role, dependency lock and provider replacement
Product-specific stale, duplicate, reordered, replay, callback and outage behavior
Bounded work, idempotency, timeout, stuck-state exit and beneficiary recovery
RPC disagreement, reorg rollback, account-model replay and target-chain capability mismatch
risks: A provider example or moving documentation page can be mistaken for target-chain deployment evidence
Provider liveness inside a PoolManager callback can trap pool execution
Silent fallback or replacement authority can rewrite the reviewed trust and economic model
A valid structural profile can be overstated as audit, provider availability, deployment or launch proof
